maker: Guangdong Bright Dream Robotics Co., Ltd. (Country Garden)
model: Concrete Ceiling Grinding Robot (混凝土天花打磨机器人)
name: Bright Dream concrete ceiling grinding robot
summary: Robot that finds bumps, steps and formwork joints over 2 mm on concrete ceilings by camera and grinds them off automatically before finishing. Made by Bright Dream in Foshan.

germany.statusNote: No route for a German buyer. Bright Dream lists the robot only on its Chinese website, whose product detail pages are blank, and its global exclusive agent BrightMaster Robotics (BMR) does not offer it. No EU dealer, customer or CE marking found.

specs.label: Defect detection
specs.value: bumps, steps and formwork joints over 2 mm, by vision
specs.quote: 能够通过视觉识别2mm以上爆点、错台、模板拼缝等缺陷

specs.label: Ceiling flatness after grinding
specs.quote: 打磨后显著提高天花平整度，极差在2mm以内

notes: Works with the tie-hole plugging and wall grinding robots for concrete repair before finishing (maker).
Mechanism and drive not described; wheels assumed.
Bright Dream says 28 of its robot types are in commercial use; this one is listed as a product, but it is not offered by BMR.
